card.title: 269th RIFLES
card.text: Becomes Veteran when you deploy a tank with 4 or more attack.
card.flavorText: The 269th Rifle Regiment was part of the 10th NKVD Rifle Division, formed on 1 February 1942, during WWII. It primarily included Border Troops from the Ural and Siberian regions, along with the 269th and 270th Regiments largely composed of Stalingrad citizens. Initially tasked with capturing enemy parachutists and saboteurs, the division became one of the first to defend Stalingrad in July 1942. In two days, the 269th Regiment inflicted over a thousand casualties and disabled 20 tanks. Throughout the battle, the division suffered heavy losses but inflicted 15,000 German casualties, destroyed 113 tanks, 8 armored vehicles, 2 aircraft, and captured a German regiment’s banner. For exemplary service in defending Stalingrad, the Soviet High Command awarded the 10th NKVD Division the Order of Lenin on 2 December 1942. However, due to heavy losses, the division was demobilized in early October 1942, with only 200 of the original 7,568 men remaining.
